Research draft T04. Judge verdicts can assert conclusions the presented evidence cannot support (verdict answerability gap).

## Done when

Judge prompt/schema constrains verdicts to an answerable set given the evidence slice; an answerability check rejects/flags verdicts referencing evidence not shown; regression fixture from the draft reproduces then passes; verdict records carry the evidence hash they judged.
